MDWC_WarcasketHelmet_Medic.description.english:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, fitted with a diagnostic visor that lets the field dressing treat disease and infection as well as wounds.

A 10th-generation spacer chassis refitted for the medic's role: the pilot is welded in for good, like any warcasket wearer, but this one is built to keep the rest of the squad alive rather than to break the line.

The medic series trades firepower for the tools to treat wounds under fire, so a squad that fields one can stay in the fight long after its stims and bandages have run out.

MDWC_FieldDressing.description.english: Apply a dose of the suite's selected medicine to every wound on a person or animal at once, at the quality the pilot's medical skill allows. With the medic helmet worn, diseases and infections are treated as well. The patient is held still while the dressing goes on.
